label: Text 1
transcript: Sam stands in the corridor of the new building. Klasse 6 has a different floor. Bigger lockers. A real chemistry room with real bunsen burners. Lina finds Sam. "Same class, different planet," she says. Mr. Flint walks past with a tray of test tubes. "Welcome back," he says, without slowing down.
